note.title: Organisms, populations, communities and habitats
note.overview: Ecology describes nested levels from one organism to populations, communities and ecosystems, plus biotic and abiotic influences.
learningGoals: Recall the precise Year 8 vocabulary for organisms, populations, communities and habitats.
Apply the knowledge rather than relying on recognition alone.
Use the command word and include every required scientific point.
mustMemoriseRules: Population: one species in an area; community: all populations; ecosystem: community plus non-living environment and interactions.
Biotic means living; abiotic means non-living.
Habitat is the place where an organism lives.
